_comment: Canopy hooks. `canopy setup` merges this into ~/.claude/settings.json and copies hooks/ to ~/.claude/canopy/hooks/. SessionStart re-injects the state digest on every session boundary; PreToolUse guards (only active when CANOPY_ROLE=orchestrator) block the orchestrator from writing to the project tree and from opening PRs directly with gh/gh-axi (use 'canopy pr open').
